Research note: These are dataset-generated moral dilemmas, not documented legal or historical precedents. Cases placed in the lower area are candidate precedents you can evaluate for relevance. Shared value tags describe dataset annotations; they are not a computed measure of analogical depth, structural similarity, or moral appropriateness. Each action branch has its own values and negative consequence.
Runs entirely in your browser. The source dataset is embedded in this HTML file; no server or internet connection is required. Board changes are saved locally in this browser when available.
